parameters.source_status: Global height/twist/foundation dimensions verified; zone interfaces proportionally reconstructed from public architect section. Intermediate floor heights, member sizes, pile arrangement and TMD physical size are teaching approximations.

verified.source: Jian Gong, Shanghai Tower, Frontiers of Engineering Management 4(1), 106–109 (2017)

steel-concrete core, megacolumns, belt/outrigger trusses and composite floors

verified.source: Gensler public section and diagrams, ArchDaily Shanghai Tower / Gensler (2016)
verified.measurement_note: Section y=1067 ground and y=0 top gives approximately 1.688 pixels per metre. Interzone deck traces near y=1005,899,780,661,540,414,277,124 imply approximately 37,100,170,240,312,387,468,559 m. Boundaries are rounded graphic estimates, not surveyed dimensions or working drawings.

verified.source: Trevor Haskett, Feeling at Home in the Clouds, STRUCTURE (2017)

verified.limitation: Concept geometry is illustrated. Exact mass-block dimensions, suspension length, support-frame detail and installation elevation are not taken from an as-built drawing.

explicit_approximations.outer_plan: Smooth harmonic rounded-triangle approximation r(theta)=r0[1+0.145 cos(3theta)] with 120 degree total twist; not the architect's fabrication spline.
explicit_approximations.floor_levels: Uniform spacing under 583 m produces representative decks; it is not the documented numbered-floor schedule.
explicit_approximations.mega_columns: Eight paired perimeter columns shown for the primary structural mechanism, with indicative rectangular sections.
explicit_approximations.pile_group: 947 representative 1 m diameter cylinders, 52 m below raft: retained as illustrative dense geometry, not a verified pile layout, quantity survey or design length.
explicit_approximations.tmd: Rectangular suspended mass at illustrative centre 578 m, four visible suspension lines, simplified rare-earth blocks and fixed copper plate.
explicit_approximations.six_skin_sectors: Animation decomposition groups only, not six real fabrication seams.
explicit_approximations.crown: Nonlevel open rim visually reconstructed from public section; only the 632 m maximum is source verified.

scientific_scope: No computational fluid dynamics, finite-element stresses, structural safety validation or construction-ready BIM is supplied by this asset. Forces drawn along this model are explanatory load paths unless an independent solver is explicitly connected.
